name: html-module-script-entry
description: An HTML file below the target root roots the file a module script's src attribute names, read against the manifest's directory for a value starting with a single slash and against the page's directory otherwise, and each file an import of an inline module script names by a specifier starting with a slash, ./ or ../. A module script inside an HTML comment roots its file too, because no markup is parsed. A source file no page, import or manifest names is reported, with the declaration inside it.
